## Hinge question {#dc3-hinge .dc-lesson }

<div data-module="hinge" data-correct="3" class="hinge numeric-choices">
<p class="hinge-question">For <span data-math="y=\sin^2(3x)"></span>, which expression is <span data-math="\frac{dy}{dx}"></span>?</p>
<div class="hinge-toolbar"><div class="time" role="timer" aria-label="Time remaining">1:00</div><div class="toolbar"><label>Seconds <select class="timer-duration" aria-label="Question duration"><option>30</option><option>45</option><option selected>60</option><option>90</option><option>120</option></select></label><button class="timer-start primary">Start</button><button class="reset-question">Reset</button></div></div>
<div class="choices">
<button class="choice" data-answer="1" aria-pressed="false"><b>1</b><span data-math="2\sin(3x)\cos(3x)"></span></button>
<button class="choice" data-answer="2" aria-pressed="false"><b>2</b><span data-math="3\cos^2(3x)"></span></button>
<button class="choice" data-answer="3" aria-pressed="false"><b>3</b><span data-math="6\sin(3x)\cos(3x)"></span></button>
<button class="choice" data-answer="4" aria-pressed="false"><b>4</b><span data-math="6\sin(3x)"></span></button>
</div>
<div class="hinge-bottom"><p>Fist on chest. Think quietly.<br>On “show”, hold up 1–4 fingers.</p><button class="reveal-answer primary">Reveal answer</button></div>
<div class="hinge-explanation" hidden><strong>3.</strong> <span data-math="2\sin(3x)\times\cos(3x)\times3"></span>. Differentiate each of the three layers.</div></div>

::: notes
Additional diagnostic, not a booklet example. Correct choice 3: y=[sin(3x)]², so y'=2 sin(3x)·cos(3x)·3. Choice 1 omits the inner factor 3. Choice 2 differentiates sine then squares the derivative instead of applying the power rule. Choice 4 omits the cosine factor from differentiating sine. Show 1–4 fingers simultaneously using the on-screen routine. 60-second timer; expiry does not reveal the answer. Ready: proceed to Example 3.7. Divided: rewrite [sin(3x)]², identify the square, sine and linear layers, then revote. Needs explanation: differentiate the square, sine and 3x separately before combining and retrying. Around three minutes.
:::
